title: What Harberger Tax Districts Is
definition: Harberger Tax Districts: districts with self-assessed property taxes.
description:
Harberger Tax Districts: districts with self-assessed property taxes. This is Post-Scarcity Economy at its most ambitious — tax registries research, district logistics engineering and valuation truth operations converging on a single goal: making district hulls real.

Why it matters: Post-Scarcity Economy will decide common ownership outcomes this century. Harberger Tax Districts is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working district hulls, the larger tax registries vision stalls, and with it, the district logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Harberger Tax Districts in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Harberger Tax Districts
title: Real Research Today: Harberger Tax Districts
definition: Today's documented research behind Harberger Tax Districts.
description:
The road to Harberger Tax Districts is already being paved. Elinor Ostrom's Nobel-winning work on governing the commons underpins commons economics. Platform cooperativism (Trebor Scholz) builds worker-owned digital platforms.

Kenya's GiveDirectly UBI trials and Stockton's SEED program tested basic income at city scale. Together these programs form the tax registries foundation that Harberger Tax Districts will build on — the district logistics results, the valuation truth methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as district logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

First city-scale district hulls pilots launch: tax registries issuance and district logistics exchange running live.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed tax registries demonstrations, district logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting valuation truth uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Harberger Tax Districts
definition: Estimates Harberger Tax Districts readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Harberger Tax Districts components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a district hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Harberger Tax Districts operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Harberger Tax Districts installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 52207 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where tax registries monitoring, district logistics redundancy, or valuation truth maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Harberger Tax Districts Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Harberger Tax Districts: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Harberger Tax Districts — districts with self-assessed property taxes.

Phase 1 — Prove (tax registries): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (district logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (valuation truth): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (common ownership): district hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
